My Mistake 🫶

Jyoti,

Main maanta hoon ki hamare breakup ki wajah mein meri anger ek badi galti thi.

Maine gusse mein react kiya, tumhe hurt kiya, aur tumhari feelings ko us waqt utna nahi samjha jitna samajhna chahiye tha.

Main apni galti ko justify nahi karna chahta. I'm genuinely sorry.

7 months mein mujhe ye samajh aaya ki kisi ko care karna sirf words nahi hota — apne behaviour ki responsibility lena bhi hota hai.
